[alex] 1789456789: Heads-up — ran into a parity/shape bug in the Python SDK: embeddings + rerank helpers + async batcher. Customer onboarding hit this in the search-demo sample app. Reproducer below, fails only when batch_size > 1.

[alex] 1789456792: Reproducer (minimal):
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
import os

client = AsyncClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))

queries = ['how to reset password', 'billing FAQ']
candidates = [['reset steps', 'account help'], ['pricing table', 'billing contact']]
# using the helper that batches candidates under the hood
scores = await client.embeddings.rerank_async(queries, candidates, use_embeddings=True, batch_size=4)
```

[alex] 1789456798: Error I see: `400 Bad Request - Invalid vector shape: expected [768], got [[...], [...]]` — basically an extra nesting level. Works fine with batch_size=1 and works sync. :confused:

[meera] 1789456803: @alex can you paste the exact SDK version + pip freeze from the env? also curious if the sample app uses the `embedding_batcher` helper or the `parallel_rerank` helper.

[alex] 1789456806: SDK 0.9.3 (pip). sample app uses the new `embedding_batcher` from examples/search_demo/batcher.py — small wrapper around `client.embeddings.create` that returns List[List[float]] for each candidate batch.

[sam] 1789456810: my hunch: rerank_async's client wrapper expects candidates as List[str] (texts) or List[List[float]] (already-embedded), but our typing & internal check only handle one nesting pattern. When batcher returns List[List[float]] per call and we then batch the batches, the client double-wraps: List[List[List[float]]], hence the shape error. Also sounds like typings are still `List[str]` in the stub so mypy won't catch it. :bug:

[tyler] 1789456812: Also saw a related issue in those long-running batches — if auth token refresh happens mid-batch we get a 401 on some requests and the retry layer treats it as fatal instead of refreshing. Customer saw half results None + half OK. We should add a retry-on-401 that triggers token refresh hook.

[meera] 1789456813: Good catch. Plan: (1) patch the batcher logic to normalize inputs before serializing (flatten one level when elements are lists of floats), (2) widen typing to `Union[List[str], List[List[str]], List[List[float]]]` and add static tests, (3) add integration test that simulates token expiry during batch and ensures client refreshes + retries.

[sam] 1789456814: I'll open a small PR for the normalization and add unit tests for async/sync parity. Will include a tiny reproducer in examples/ that uses batch_size=4. cc @meera @tyler

[dev-bot] 1789456815: deploy-bot: created issue #4321 (embeddings-rerank: async batcher extra-nesting + 401 retry) and assigned to sam, meera. :white_check_mark:

[alex] 1789456815: Awesome — thanks. For the onboarding docs, can we add a short note in quickstart that `embedding_batcher` returns nested lists and to ensure you pass `use_embeddings=True` only when you have raw vectors? Lost 30 min on that with the customer. :facepalm:
